key_points.text: My guest today is Rebecca Kaden, a partner at famed venture firm Union Square Ventures.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest today is Rebecca Kaden, a partner at famed venture firm Union Square Ventures.

thesis: The speaker argues that Union Square Ventures' investment thesis evolved from a focus on horizontal network effects to vertical networks and decentralized infrastructure, and now centers on broadening access and driving value while reducing costs by building on top of existing platforms and protocols. The firm believes that while early internet growth was dominated by centralized platforms, the next opportunity lies in leveraging the infrastructure and protocols created to systematically improve access and efficiency.
